The mysterious '''Yarkora homeworld'''<ref name="UAA" /> was located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] unknown to the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community,<ref name="SWTSSE">According to the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', the [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was from an unknown [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Thus, it can be determined that the Yarkora [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was located in an unknown [[Star/Legends|star]] system.</ref> within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SWCE" /> It remained undiscovered by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] since the first recorded encounter with a [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]],<ref name="UAA" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="Dating">According to ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', the first recorded encounter wiith a [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] occured three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] to the year [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it can be determined that this encounter took place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> [[Xenobiologist/Legends|Xenoscientists]] speculated that they originated in an arid climate, evolving to become the dominant [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of their secret [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yarkora homeworld was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] [[roleplaying game]] supplement written by [[Eric Cagle]], [[Cory J. Herndon]], [[Michael Mikaelian]], [[Steve Miller]], [[Owen K.C. Stephens]], and [[J.D. Wiker]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="UAA" />
